equipment_type: Chiller plant controller (chillers and chilled water pumps)
applies_to: Armstrong SE-A20 chilled water plant controls with no condenser water side; the object list covers up to 5 chillers, 10 chilled water pumps and 5 control zones.
summary: The SE-A20 is the larger version of the SE-A10: up to 5 chillers, 5 zones and 10 chilled water pump positions (dualArm/Twin pump sides count separately), with no condenser water or tower objects. The BACnet list gives plant start/stop, alarm reset, plant load, power and efficiency, chilled water temperatures and flow, chiller and pump status, alarms, drive data and Hand/Auto overrides.
notes: The data-points sheet titles the table BACnet but does not say whether it is BACnet IP or MS/TP.
Mode objects (AV) use 0 = Not Used, 1 = Hand, 2 = Off, 3 = Auto. Duty/standby, chiller duty and chiller state objects are coded values; the codes are in each point's states.
Hand/Auto BVs and Hand Command BVs, plus the Hand Speed / Hand Position AOs, let the BMS run a valve or pump by hand. Set Lead objects act only when the written value changes.
Units for temperatures, pressures and flows follow the controller's unit setting (the PDF lists the options).

Footnote asterisks after some pump names in the PDF are left off the object names. They mean: for dualArm or Twin pumps, pump numbers 1-5 are the A sides and 6-10 the B sides, and those pumps only report duty or standby because they run in dedicated mode with their chiller.
The PDF table is on pages 9-13. One Reserved AI is left out.

integration.summary: The SE-A20 publishes a fixed BACnet object list. Start and stop the plant with BO 1 Remote Start, write the zone setpoint (AV 2), and read BI 1 Plant Status, plant load, chilled water temperatures, plant power and efficiency. Use BO 3 to reset alarms. Per-chiller, per-pump and per-valve alarms, run feedbacks and Hand/Auto overrides are there if the BMS needs more detail.

minimum_points.name: Remote Start
minimum_points.why: Plant start/stop from the BMS (1 = start)

integration.enable: BO 1 Remote Start (0 = Stop, 1 = Start) starts and stops the plant from the BMS. The data-points sheet says nothing more about local/remote selection.
setup: The data-points sheet does not give the device instance, MAC address, baud rate or IP settings; get them from the controller setup.
gotchas: BO 3 Alarm Reset acts on a positive edge (0 to 1); write 0 again before the next reset.
Hand/Auto BVs and Hand Command / Hand Speed objects override the plant sequence; leave them in Auto for normal operation.
Mode AVs are coded 0-3 (1 = Hand, 2 = Off, 3 = Auto); writing them takes that equipment out of automatic sequencing.
Set Lead Chiller / Pump objects act only when the value changes, so rewriting the same value does nothing.
